display_name: The Martyrs of Nicomedia with four tribunes

names.form: Sfinții 4 Mucenici tribuni, împreună cu cei 1003 mucenici din Nicomidia
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 februarie. The calendar's whole line is the only name it gives them; it names no member of the company.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Χίλιοι Τρεις Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στη Νικομήδεια», with the rank word and the relative clause left off. The Greek line counts the thousand and three and does not name the four tribunes the Romanian line names beside them.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: «Мчч. 1003 Никомидийских (303).» The 1003 is the company's number, not a year.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 февраля ст. ст. — «Мчч. 1003 Никомидийских (303).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 februarie — «Sfinții 4 Mucenici tribuni, împreună cu cei 1003 mucenici din Nicomidia»

attestations.note: Their own page on the site carries the line, the date and the readings appointed for martyrs, and no life and no troparion. The company is not enumerated, so it is kept here as one entry.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιοι Χίλιοι Τρεις Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στη Νικομήδεια»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
